lastCompletedStory.title: Adopt new schema in the issue writer (issue-file.ts) and ship-finalize reader

nextStoryContext: US-004 is complete. Both issue-file.ts and ship-finalize.ts now import IssueEntry and IssuesLocalJson from src/issues/types.ts; the local duplicate interfaces are removed. New issues are written with stage:'idea', status:'open', blockedBy:[] (state:'open' and priority write are gone). ship-finalize stamps stage:'shipped' instead of state:'closed' (closedAt dropped; clock param stays in interface for backward compat but is not destructured). knip.json no longer ignores src/issues/types.ts (it is now reachable via two import sites). The next story (US-005) gates on selectPlannableIssue from src/issues/select.ts and should make cam-plan Step 2 delegate to selectPlannableFromFile. Key gotcha: the IssueEntry from types.ts has no index signature and no state/closedAt fields. Any code that reads existing issues.local.json files with old-format entries (state:'open') and casts via JSON.parse as IssuesLocalJson will work fine at runtime since TypeScript casts are not validated; however, unit test fixtures should use the new schema to avoid confusion.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal type migration: replaced local IssueEntry/IssuesLocalJson duplicates with imports from src/issues/types.ts. No external library API exercised.
